summary: No fatal error found in the lower-bound argument. Exact rational recombination confirms the reported lower bound from the supplied sector intervals. Two numerical statements in PROOFS §3 need correction. Acceptance remains conditional on those sector intervals: python-flint was unavailable, so I could not independently rerun the Arb certification.

issues.description: The displayed flush-budget inequality is false: 10^6 × 10^8 × 2^-900 = 1.183052186e-257, not less than 2e-262. This does not invalidate ABS_ENTRY=1e-250: even multiplying the corrected budget by 16 phase parts remains below it.
issues.fix: Replace the numerical estimate with less than 1.2e-257 and explicitly account for summing phase parts.

issues.description: The claim that DD representation error for pi is at most 1e-40 in practice is incorrect. For N=1344, s=943, exact rational conversion to nearest hi-plus-lo gives relative error about 2.06539e-33. The logged relE values are consistent with including errors of this size; the implementation explicitly adds pis_rel, so this textual error does not invalidate the bound.
issues.fix: Remove the 1e-40 assertion and report the measured max(pis_rel), distinguishing DD representation error from Arb evaluation uncertainty.

issues.description: Both scripts import cert, but the packet contains no cert.py. They therefore cannot resolve the intended implementation using only the supplied files.
issues.fix: Import cert_SNAPSHOT_used_for_result explicitly, or document a read-only launcher that registers that snapshot as module cert in memory.

issues.description: The supplied 220 sectors exactly match ptail=1e-13, covering even N from 1236 through 1674. The default ptail=1e-30 selects 344 sectors. The actual threshold is absent from the result metadata. The supplied omitted-mass correction is nevertheless correct.
issues.fix: Record ptail=1e-13, pitail=1e-40, and the invocation used to produce the result.

issues.description: Sector records contain no witness or implementation fingerprint. combine.py stamps the supplied witness hash without checking that the sector records belong to it. I found no actual mismatch in this packet, but record provenance cannot be verified from these fields.
issues.fix: Include witness and implementation hashes in sector records and verify them when combining.

issues.description: python-flint was unavailable. I did not execute entropy_enclosure, regenerate the 2000-qubit sector certificates, or independently reproduce the published control. The supplied control JSON and smoke log were inspected as recorded results.
issues.fix: Rerun the Arb path with an existing python-flint installation before treating this review as independent numerical reproduction.

checked: §1: Checked the sector decomposition, p_N and pi_s normalization formulas, and cancellation of multiplicity entropies. For M=2000 and eta=11/15, exact integer arithmetic confirms sum_N p_N=1.

§2: Checked loss/add indices and Horner recursion. Independent closed-form Kraus calculations agreed with small DD outputs within 2.23e-16. Sampled checkpoint replay was bitwise identical to uninterrupted descent. Loss retains the complete input support before output truncation.

§3: Checked nonnegative splitting, disjoint-support merging for all three witness operator pairs, the chain-length allowance, explicit pi error inclusion, and entry-radius inflation. Exact-rational checks found no failures for integer square roots through 2001, reciprocals through 2002, or sampled DD operations including underflow. These samples supplement the error argument.

§4: Checked the single-flag channel, diagonal RB flag from distinct residues, flag normalization, almost-convexity correction, and Araki–Lieb remainder. Exact rational checks confirmed every recorded smin threshold and that every eps_tail encloses the omitted pi mass.

§5: Found no sign error in Ostrowski scaling, enlarged Gershgorin component counting, h_range clipping/monotonicity, or outward endpoint conversion. An Arb sum hi+lo need not always be exact at 160 bits, but its ball retains rounding uncertainty. The later Ky Fan refinement is conservative on inspection; it was not used for this result.

Aggregation: All 220 sectors are unique and complete for ptail=1e-13. Exact omitted mass is approximately 3.623063122427081e-13. Exact recombination confirms the reported lower and upper endpoints are outward bounds on the weighted supplied intervals.

Witness: Confirmed M=2000, p=1/5, q=(1/2,1/2), residues 0 and 1 modulo 3, finite binary64 amplitudes, and support within the Dicke basis. The code applies the required normalization; disjoint supports imply S(rho)=1 exactly.
Integrity: Every listed SHA256 checksum matches, and the canonical witness hash matches M2000_p1_5_TOTAL.json.
first_verification_step: Using python3 -B with python-flint already available, load the snapshot as module cert in memory and call certify on the witness with sectors_only={1466}, ptail=1e-13, pitail=1e-40, verbose=False, and no log. Compare the returned sector interval with the recorded N=1466 entry without writing files.
